messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: Unity update on unity_video_retarget: they agreed to credit part of the July spend as invalid traffic. The pattern hasn't stopped though: last week was still ~8% CTR, ~$0.50 CPI, and D1 around 15%. Spend has been flat at ~$2.7k/day the whole time.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Then we pause the campaign from Sep 1 and move its budget to unity_playable_installs, which is still clean (CPI ~$1.16, CTR 1.6%). I'll take it to #marketing-leads.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Note for anyone reading the dashboards: the campaign's D7 ROAS looks normal because the fake installs add no revenue but also no spend. Payer conversion and D1 are where it shows.
